steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace && ls -la /app 2>/dev/null || ls -la; echo "---"; for f in /app/*.ics; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Meeting Scheduler//Team Planning Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:REQUEST",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    "UID:team-planning-meeting-20240117@example.com",
    "DTSTAMP:20240101T000000Z",
    "DTSTART:20240117T110000Z",
    "DTEND:20240117T120000Z",
    "SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:1-hour planning meeting for Alice, Bob, and Carol.",
    "LOCATION:Conference Room",
    "ORGANIZER;CN=Meeting Scheduler:mailto:scheduler@example.com",
    "ATTENDEE;CN=Alice;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT;PARTSTAT=NEEDS-ACTION;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:alice@example.com",
    "ATTENDEE;CN=Bob;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT;PARTSTAT=NEEDS-ACTION;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:bob@example.com",
    "ATTENDEE;CN=Carol;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT;PARTSTAT=NEEDS-ACTION;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:carol@example.com",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]
Path("/app/meeting_scheduled.ics").write_bytes(("\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n").encode("ascii"))
PY
echo "--- file ---"
cat /app/meeting_scheduled.ics
echo "--- validation ---"
python3 - <<'PY'
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar
    c = Calendar.from_ical(open('/app/meeting_scheduled.ics','rb').read())
    for e in c.walk('VEVENT'):
        print(e['SUMMARY'], e['DTSTART'].dt, e['DTEND'].dt)
        print([str(a) for a in e['ATTENDEE']])
except ImportError:
    print("icalendar not installed; basic format check")
    data = open('/app/meeting_scheduled.ics').read()
    assert data.startswith('BEGIN:VCALENDAR')
    assert data.rstrip().endswith('END:VCALENDAR')
    print('basic format OK')
PY
EOF
